content.text: This clause set fully meets the preferred position, so no redline is warranted.

input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets the preferred position on every material term. 24.1 gives us consent-free assignment to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets (subject only to prompt notice and assignee assumption, which is acceptable). 24.2 binds Vendor asymmetrically in our favour: no assignment, delegation of material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent (reasonableness qualified only as to capable, financially sound assignees), and never to a direct Customer competitor without our consent. 24.3 leaves a mutual not-unreasonably-withheld standard for residual assignments. 24.4 expressly denies Vendor any right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees or reduce service on our change of control, and requires cooperation with administrative changes for a permitted successor — squarely avoiding walk-away territory. 13.3 aligns the licence transfer right with a Section 24 permitted assignment. A document-wide search confirms no other change-of-control trigger; 9.2 is an insolvency clause and expressly states a lawful reorganization is not by itself grounds for termination. No redline needed.
